hooks.command: cmd="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then msg=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -nE 's/.*-m *[\"\x27]([^\"\x27]+)[\"\x27].*/\1/p'); if [ -n "$msg" ] && ! echo "$msg" | grep -qE '^(feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|test|perf|ci|build)(\([^)]+\))?!?: .+'; then echo 'commit-msg-lint: message does not match Conventional Commits' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
